description: Verify ROWS physical average and RANGE cumulative calculations
setupSql:
CREATE TABLE repayments (id INT, loan_id INT, payment_date VARCHAR(10), amount NUMERIC);
INSERT INTO repayments VALUES (1, 101, '2026-01-01', 100), (2, 101, '2026-01-02', 200), (3, 101, '2026-01-03', 300);
expectedOutputSql: SELECT id, loan_id, payment_date, amount, AVG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY loan_id ORDER BY payment_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS physical_2row_avg, SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY loan_id ORDER BY amount RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS range_accum_sum FROM repayments ORDER BY loan_id, payment_date;
